title: CollabShell 2.1.1
release_notes:
- Sessions no longer die after hours idle — the runtime proxy token now refreshes automatically on resume, session sync, and 404
- Terminal tabs reconnect with a fresh token instead of erroring
- Files browser self-heals after long sessions
- Kernel execution no longer drops a live session on a stale token
- Update notifications: version chip and changelog dialog
- Check for Updates button in the version dialog
